metadata.description: Claude Code mods for status lines, screenshot history, prompt caching, and budget awareness.

plugins.name: neo-statusline
plugins.description: One-line status bar under the prompt: model, effort, git, context, prompt cache, subagents, rate limits, cost.

plugins.name: budget-guard
plugins.description: Stretches a Claude subscription: keeps the main prompt cache warm while idle, warns on 5h/7d limits and an approaching compaction, guards prompts sent into a cold cache.

plugins.name: neo-screenshots
plugins.description: Searchable image history from Read and MCP tools, with saved snapshots opened in the system viewer.
